initial_prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 architectural construction reference, high-resolution detailed four-view sheet. Design ONE identical coherent modular structure shown in four panels, NOT four different structures. Large front-left three-quarter view, large back-right three-quarter view, clear overhead axonometric plan and a front-elevation/entrance detail with a normal Minecraft door as a scale anchor. Neutral off-white studio background, soft daylight, sharp full-depth focus, legible individual voxel blocks and realistic vanilla Minecraft textures. Faithful buildable block geometry, block-thickness beams, slabs/stairs/walls/iron bars, no smoothly curved unbuildable surfaces. No cinematic atmosphere, terrain island, people, aircraft, inventory crates, logos or text labels. Keep window counts, footprints, supports, roof and staircase placement consistent across views. Shared visual family: rugged industrial security facility, light stone and quartz infill, dark deepslate structural supports and plinths, muted cyan-blue panels, narrow yellow safety lines, gray glass, warm small lanterns. Many varied materials and carefully articulated reveals, eaves, sills and bases, NOT a plain box. No iron/gold/diamond/netherite/emerald blocks or beacons. Empty interiors for later furnishing. Avoid giant proportions: normal door leaf two blocks tall, human-scaled railings, structural pillars generally one or two blocks thick. Provide enough detail to translate directly into a block model. A modular perimeter security demonstration wall and compact duty/reception house. An L-shaped composition: a long three-bay layered gray demonstration wall runs along the rear/left of an open paved inspection court, a compact two-level blue-white reception house is at the RIGHT end, making a clearly asymmetrical silhouette. Main front door faces the open front court. Each display wall bay has recessed gray panels and a narrow cyan accent strip, thick visible buttresses and empty mount faces (no weapons). Behind the wall is a narrow high maintenance walkway with iron railings. A real three-block-wide straight exterior stair at the LEFT end reaches the wall walkway; walkway connects to the upper door of the house. Reception house flat stepped roof, continuous narrow high windows, inset blue vertical frontage, slightly projecting slab entrance canopy, column bases, lamps. Roof has a small passive antenna mast only. Wide uninterrupted public path in front of wall connects to house door. Human-scaled house about nine blocks facade width and two modest levels; whole module roughly a thirty-block-wide court, size descriptive not a drawing label. No H marking or cargo landing zone on this module.

final_prompts.prompt: Edit the supplied FOUR-VIEW Minecraft building reference sheet. Keep its architectural identity, detailed materials and four-view presentation, but RE-DESIGN THE BLOCK SCALE to the following concrete modular dimensions before final NBT construction. This is a scale-constrained design reference, not a pasted dimension caption on the same oversized object. Final footprint EXACTLY 32 blocks X by 24 blocks Z, overall height no more than 23 blocks. Four short wall bays each about FOUR blocks wide. Reception house NINE blocks wide, main floor Y=5, upper floor and wall walkway Y=10, roof Y=16. Deck surface Y=4. Wall stair THREE blocks wide rising SIX blocks. One ordinary door leaf ONE wide and TWO tall. Keep house at right, exterior stair at left. Show every view as the SAME coherent design. Make standard-size doors, individual stair treads, pillar widths and slab thickness readable; do not miniaturize these elements to force the fit. Overhead panel should be an orthographic block-grid plan with a thin one-block grid and dimension arrows for overall X/Z; add unobtrusive numeric labels for overall dimensions and a 1x2 door detail. Architectural three-quarter views must remain high-quality detailed Minecraft construction renders. No perspective exaggeration. Do not add furniture or cargo. No iron/gold/diamond/netherite/emerald blocks or beacons. Preserve gray/quartz/deepslate, muted cyan and yellow accent materials. Explicit dimensions override all earlier visual scale. No H or cargo landing pad on this module.
